infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Xaylens to access your camera to capture photos, record videos, and apply live face lenses.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Xaylens to access your microphone to record audio with your video lenses.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Xaylens to access your photo library to save your creative media.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Xaylens to save photos and videos to your photo library.
